slides.title:
A window that finishes
two hours early is
*not* good news.
Usually nothing
slides.body:
Not on *purpose*.
The work went in clean.
The team was tired.

slides.title: The gap
slides.body:
Those aren't the same state.
The gap between them is where
*Monday morning* lives.

slides.title: The false signal
slides.body:
By every signal
available at 2am,
it *worked*.

slides.title: Monday
slides.body:
Real traffic, real patterns.
Something that only shows
*under load* starts failing.

slides.title: The real fault
slides.body:
The window wasn't too short.
The *definition of done*
was too small.

slides.title: Write it down first
slides.body:
A named condition,
a named owner.
Not "confirm change successful."

slides.title:
Applied is a change
you *made*.
slides.body:
Verified is one
you can *defend*.
